svg.title: KRONOS spatial adaptation and final classifier
svg.desc: Each patch has a frozen 768-value KRONOS embedding. Only available orthogonal neighbours in the same permitted scope enter a uniform mean; no neighbours gives zero. Learned self and neighbour matrices plus bias and ReLU produce H spatial features. Labelled training patches fit the spatial map and a temporary linear head with bias using cross-entropy and Adam. Dedicated update arrows name all fitted parameters. The spatial map is then frozen; the same labelled targets fit selected normalization and either RF or SVM. Application uses the fixed encoder, saved spatial map, normalization and chosen classifier, and rasterizes patch classes inside eligible scope. All grids, features, parameters, trees and SVM positions are schematic.
svg.text: Freeze the spatial map; fit the selected final classifier
Apply the saved calculation to eligible patches
